+ # Exa Recruiting Agent Automation
+ 
+ ## Introduction / Problem
+ 
+ This rule documents a repeatable pattern for automating the process of discovering, researching, and evaluating candidates using Exa search and LLMs. It is based on the [Exa Recruiting Agent tutorial](mdc:https:/docs.exa.ai/examples/exa-recruiting-agent). The approach is useful for recruiting, lead generation, or any workflow that requires enrichment and scoring of people or entities from minimal initial data (e.g., name/email).
+ 
+ ## Pattern Description
+ 
+ ### 1. Initial Candidate List
+ - Start with a list of names/emails (e.g., from a CSV or manual entry).
+ 
+ ```python
+ sample_data = {
+     "Name": ["Kristy Choi", "Jiaming Song", ...],
+     "Email": ["kristy@cmu.edu", "jiaming@stanford.edu", ...]
+ }
+ students_df = pd.DataFrame(sample_data)
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. Information Enrichment
+ - Use LLM (OpenAI) to extract school from email.
+ - Use Exa keyword search to find LinkedIn profiles (restrict to linkedin.com).
+ - Use Exa keyword search (excluding major platforms) to find personal websites and scrape their content.
+ 
+ ```python
+ def extract_school_from_email(email):
+     content = f"I'm going to give you a student's email. ... Here is their email: {email}"
+     return get_openai_response(content)
+ 
+ def get_linkedin_from_name(name, school=''):
+     query = f"{name} {school}"
+     keyword_search = exa.search(query, num_results=1, type="keyword", include_domains=['linkedin.com'])
+     ...
+ 
+ def exa_search_personal_website(name, school=''):
+     query = f"{name} {school}"
+     keyword_search = exa.search_and_contents(query, type="keyword", text={"include_html_tags": False}, num_results=1, exclude_domains=['linkedin.com', 'github.com', 'twitter.com'])
+     ...
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 3. Attribute Extraction from Website Content
+ - Use LLM to extract undergrad, current role, research topics, and AI status from scraped content.
+ 
+ ```python
+ def extract_undergrad_from_contents(contents):
+     ...
+ def extract_current_role_from_contents(contents):
+     ...
+ def extract_research_topics_from_contents(contents):
+     ...
+ def extract_is_ai_from_contents(contents):
+     ...
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 4. Candidate Evaluation
+ - Use LLM to score candidates 1-10 based on fit to your criteria.
+ 
+ ```python
+ def calculate_score(info, undergrad, year, researchTopics, AI):
+     ...
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 5. Enrichment Loop
+ - For each candidate, enrich with all the above, then sort by score.
+ 
+ ```python
+ def enrich_row(row):
+     ...
+ enriched_df = students_df.progress_apply(enrich_row, axis=1)
+ sorted_df = enriched_df.sort_values(by='Score', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 6. Finding More Candidates
+ - Use Exa's `find_similar_and_contents` on top candidate homepages to discover more similar profiles.
+ - Extract name/email from new profiles using LLM.
+ 
+ ```python
+ def get_more_candidates(homepageURL):
+     ...
+ def get_name_from_contents(contents):
+     ...
+ def get_email_from_contents(contents):
+     ...
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Real-World Examples
+ - See the full [Exa Recruiting Agent tutorial](mdc:https:/docs.exa.ai/examples/exa-recruiting-agent) for a working Colab notebook and code.
+ - Example use cases: AI researcher recruiting, customer discovery, expert finding, lead generation.
+ 
+ ## Common Pitfalls / Anti-Patterns
+ - Not filtering domains when searching for personal websites (leads to irrelevant results).
+ - Over-relying on LLM extraction without validating outputs.
+ - Not handling missing or ambiguous data (e.g., no LinkedIn found).
+ - Failing to respect API rate limits or error handling for Exa/OpenAI.
+
